facts.fact: The Eswatini Revenue Service lists MoMo Pay among the payment options open to taxpayers, as stated by ERS's Taxpayer Education manager.

ERS says filing and payment of the 2026 annual returns is 100 per cent online through Tax-Ease or the TaxPAL app, with payment by EFT, bank deposit, MoMo Pay or speed point, and no manual returns accepted.

SWZ.note: Document mentions an active Taxpayer Identification Number and online profile updates but does not say numbers are issued from a computerised register.
